title: Markovian Dynamics Enforcer: Feasibility Preserving Correction on Learned Dynamics Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2609.39888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural trajectory predictors can reach low prediction error while violating dynamics, actuator limits, or state constraints, especially when controls are unobserved and dynamics are partially specified. We introduce the Markovian Dynamics Enforcer (MaDE), a time-invariant post-hoc operator mapping state-transition proposals onto a learned feasible dynamics manifold, trained on feasible states without ground-truth controls. For each transition it infers a control and recomputes the state through a completion model of known physics plus a learned residual. It then corrects that control by gradient-based inequality reduction, so inequality satisfaction is best-effort within an iteration budget. Since every correction iterate re-enters the completion model, the returned state is dynamically consistent by construction relative to that model and the supplied previous-state anchor. translated_title: 马尔可夫动力学执行器：在学习到的动力学流形上保持可行性的校正
translated_abstract: 神经轨迹预测器可以在违反动力学规律、执行器限制或状态约束的同时达到较低的预测误差，尤其是在控制输入不可观测且动力学仅部分已知的情形下。我们提出了马尔可夫动力学执行器，这是一个时不变的事后校正算子，它将状态转移提议映射到一个学习得到的可行动力学流形上，其训练仅使用可行状态而无需真实的控制标签。对于每一次状态转移，它先推断出一个控制量，并通过一个由已知物理加上学习残差构成的补全模型重新计算状态。随后，它通过基于梯度的不等式缩减来校正该控制量，因此不等式约束的满足是在迭代预算内的尽力而为。由于每一次校正迭代都会重新进入补全模型，返回的状态相对于该模型以及所提供的上一状态锚点在构造上就是动力学一致的。MaDE 在完全指定的模型上能将动力学残差降低到几乎为零
tldr: MaDE 是一个时不变的事后校正算子，它在无需真实控制标签的情况下推断控制量，并通过结合已知物理与学习残差的补全模型将状态转移映射到可行的动力学流形上，从而在构造上保证返回状态与动力学一致。
en_tdlr: MaDE is a time-invariant post-hoc operator that maps state-transition proposals onto a learned feasible dynamics manifold by inferring controls and recomputing states through a completion model of known physics plus a learned residual, guaranteeing dynamically consistent corrections without ground-truth controls.
